name: Angels And Humans
overview: Scripture reveals that angels are mighty ministering spirits sent by God to serve and protect His people, as seen in Psalms 91:11 and Hebrews 1:14. They faithfully obey God's commands and rejoice over the repentance of sinners, highlighting their role in God's redemptive plan (Psalms 103:20; Luke 15:10). Additionally, angels are also associated with judgment, as Matthew 25:41 warns of their eternal condemnation alongside the devil. These verses collectively emphasize the distinct yet interconnected roles of angels and humans within God's sovereign purposes.
